title: Renewal Figures for the HomeShield Programs
content:
Homeowners Insurance renews for one-year terms, and three HomeShield program figures apply at each renewal.

| Program | Renewal offer sent, calendar days before expiration | Cap on the renewal premium increase before discounts | Inflation guard increase of Coverage A at renewal |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 45 | 15 percent | 4 percent |
| HomeShield Standard | 45 | 15 percent | 4 percent |
| HomeShield Plus | 45 | 15 percent | 4 percent |
| HomeShield Preferred | 45 | 12 percent | 5 percent |
| HomeShield Premier | 45 | 12 percent | 5 percent |
| HomeShield Estate | 45 | 10 percent | 6 percent |

## The three figures

- **Renewal offer timing**: the number of calendar days before expiration on which the renewal offer is sent; 45 days in every program.
- **Renewal increase cap**: the cap, as a percentage, on the renewal premium increase before discounts.
- **Inflation guard**: the automatic percentage increase of Coverage A at renewal.

## Comparison by program family

The higher programs carry a larger inflation guard and a tighter increase cap. HomeShield Essential, Standard and Plus pair a 4 percent inflation guard with a 15 percent cap; HomeShield Preferred and Premier pair 5 percent with 12 percent; HomeShield Estate pairs 6 percent with 10 percent.

**Illustration (hypothetical expiring premium before discounts of 3,000.00 dollars).** The cap allows a renewal premium before discounts of no more than 3,450.00 dollars under a 15 percent cap, 3,360.00 dollars under a 12 percent cap, and 3,300.00 dollars under a 10 percent cap.
